_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The performance-hud flag shows the HUD with live counters. The flag is on. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} was started with "echo perf-hud-on". "The HUD" is the ".perf-hud" element. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. The element with data-testid "message-input" should be visible (allow 30s). 3. The HUD should be visible (allow 10s). 4. The HUD's first "tbody tr" should be visible (allow 5s): loading a conversation mounts messages, which count. 5. The HUD must hold exactly 0 ".perf-hud-empty" elements (its "no counters yet" row). 6. Click the HUD's ".perf-hud-title" (not the header's right side: its reset/copy/pause buttons stop the click). 7. Eval document.querySelector('.perf-hud').classList.contains('collapsed') until it returns true. 8. The HUD's ".perf-hud-mini" should be visible. 9. Click the HUD's ".perf-hud-title" again. 10. Long tasks (main-thread blocks over 50ms) get their own section. Reset the counters, register a sentinel counter, then block the main thread in a real event-loop task (work run directly in a DevTools evaluate is not reported as a long task), with exactly this eval: new Promise((resolve) => { const perf = window.__shelleyPerf; perf.reset(); perf.count('test.suspect'); setTimeout(() => { const t0 = performance.now(); while (performance.now() - t0 < 80) {} resolve('blocked'); }, 0); }), expecting "blocked". 11. The HUD's first ".perf-hud-longtask" should be visible (allow 5s). 12. The HUD's ".perf-hud-longtask-suspects" element containing "test.suspect" (has_text) should be visible: the sentinel is a suspect for that long task.

steps.expression: new Promise((resolve) => { const perf = window.__shelleyPerf; perf.reset(); perf.count('test.suspect'); setTimeout(() => { const t0 = performance.now(); while (performance.now() - t0 < 80) {} resolve('blocked'); }, 0); })
